items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Spiegel was in the band then.

ctx.x: So only with musicians did we cut any ice and they used to come up there quite a bit. But, of course, they came

up to listen to Bix and Trumbauer and Don Murray and Spiegel was in the band then. Spiegel used to have some kind of jug tone, and he played a megaphone and he'd play these melodic tunes and waltzes and he used to eat those things up. They liked that. He was the commercial part of our band.
You said they brought in Lang and Venuti.

items.title: Spiegle Willcox and Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Norwich, New York, November 14, 1995
items.q: Of course we had Bill Challis, Bill was with Whiteman then of course.

ctx.x: Yeah, but you had sweet tunes also. Like “Whispering” that Paul Whiteman made famous. Oh, God, so many beautiful tunes.
Of course we had Bill Challis, Bill was with Whiteman then of course.
That’s right. I knew Bill from New York.
